about_short_description.short_description: El-Kheta is an educational platform that provides supplementary lessons to support Egyptian school students in their studies.

product.name: Comprehensive Video Lessons
product.description: El-Kheta offers detailed video lessons covering all parts of the curriculum for Egyptian school students.

product.name: Interactive Exercises and Assignments
product.description: After each lesson, students can engage in interactive exercises and assignments to reinforce their learning.

product.name: Intensive Exam Reviews
product.description: Before exams, El-Kheta provides comprehensive and intensive review sessions to help students prepare effectively.

product.name: Printable Summaries
product.description: Students have access to ready-to-print summaries for each lesson to aid in their study and revision.

product.name: Personal Academic Supervisor
product.description: Each student is assigned a personal supervisor to monitor their academic progress.

product.name: Direct Teacher Communication
product.description: Students can directly communicate with teachers to get answers to their questions.
